description: Pure C# implementations of major compression algorithm families: LZ, Entropy, BWT, and Specialized codecs.

algorithms.LzMatchFinder: Sliding-window best-match finder shared by all LZ variants
algorithms.SnappyCompressor: Google Snappy — hash-table LZ77, variable-length integer encoding
algorithms.LzavCompressor: LZAV — chained hash table, chain-length limited to 16
algorithms.Lz4Compressor: LZ4 — token-based format, 4-byte header, nibble match lengths
algorithms.ZstandardCompressor: Zstandard-style — LZ77 tokenization + Huffman literal coding

algorithms.SymbolStatistics: Frequency counting, Shannon entropy, compressed-size estimation
algorithms.HuffmanTree: Greedy Huffman tree builder with canonical code assignment
algorithms.HuffmanCompressor: Bit-packed Huffman codec with 256-byte length-table header
algorithms.RansCompressor: Range ANS — power-of-2 normalized frequencies, reverse encode

algorithms.BurrowsWheelerTransform: Full suffix-sort BWT with Forward/Inverse static methods
algorithms.RunLengthEncoder: RLE for MTF output — (value, count) byte pairs, capped at 255
algorithms.Bzip2StyleCompressor: bzip2-style pipeline: BWT → MTF → RLE → Huffman, block-based

algorithms.BrotliStaticDictionary: Static dictionary of common English/HTML/JS phrases
algorithms.LzmaRangeCoder: Arithmetic range coder — 11-bit adaptive probability, LSB flush
algorithms.LzmaMarkovModel: Context-dependent Markov probability tables for LZMA literals/lengths
algorithms.LzmaCompressor: LZMA — range coder + Markov model + LZ77 match finding
algorithms.OpenZlStructureAnalyzer: CSV/JSON structure detector — column entropy analysis
algorithms.OpenZlCompressor: Columnar rearrangement for tabular data before entropy coding
